args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the v2.3.1 production deploy. Per the runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with error rate ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed until the root cause of the failed health checks is resolved.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Investigated**: Deploy history showed v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified**: Service is now healthy across all regions on v2.3.0, with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failed health checks, the rollback to v2.3.0, and post-rollback verification. The on-call engineer has been paged.
